name: contract-artifact-byte-snapshot
goal: Validate, hash and store the same generated audio bytes even when the input uses an own getter

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: capture reads input.bytes separately for WAV validation, hashing and persistence. A getter can supply a different valid waveform on later reads, so returned media identity and saved audio can describe different data than validation examined.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing one capture/initialized case supplies a plain Buffer and misses repeat reads of accepted getter properties. Strengthen that same case with an own bytes getter returning two distinct valid WAV buffers. Assert one read, original authored hash and identical stored bytes; retain the existing plain-buffer and invalid-property checks. No additional test declarations.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
